Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 szDonorID varchar2(10);
 szProcedureCode varchar2(5);
 szDonationType varchar2(5);
 szCollDate date;
 szEligStatus varchar2(5);
 szDeferDate date;
 szDeferReason varchar2(50);
 szInterType varchar2(10);
 
 cursor cur_procdesc is
 select description
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :valid_donproc_codes.procedure_code;

begin

 if :valid_donproc_codes.procedure_code is not null then
 open cur_procdesc;
 fetch cur_procdesc
 into :valid_donproc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 if cur_procdesc%NOTFOUND then
 :valid_donproc_codes.proc_code_desc := 'Not available';
 end if;
 if cur_procdesc%ISOPEN then
 close cur_procdesc;
 end if;

 szDonorID := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 szProcedureCode := :valid_donproc_codes.procedure_code;
 szDonationType := 'AL';
 --szCollDate := sysdate; -- V03
 szCollDate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time( :GLOBAL.tz_enabled, 
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset, 
 SYSDATE
 ); 
 don_core.check_eligibility(szDonorID,
 szProcedureCode,
 szDonationType,
 szCollDate,
 NULL, -- donor weight -- Pkg takes wt from donors table when NULL is passed.
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 --if szInterType = 'PERMD' then -- Commented by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 29
 if szInterType = 'PERMD' and 
 szDeferReason in ('Donor is indefinitely deferred.', 'Donor deferred (Def Type in REGIS)') then -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2015. IM 29
 :ctrl_block.inter_type := 'PERMD';
 end if;

 :valid_donproc_codes.deferral_date := szDeferDate;
 :valid_donproc_codes.deferral_reason := szDeferReason;
 if szEligStatus = 'Y' then
 :valid_donproc_codes.elig_status := 'Yes';
 else
 :valid_donproc_codes.elig_status := 'No';
 end if;

 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUNOTHER_FORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUNOTHER_FORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will do the actual work.
*/
PROCEDURE populate_donors IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := '';
 szChapter varchar2(5) ;
 v_multi_chap varchar2(5);
BEGIN
 szDonorID := :parameter.P_DONOR_ID;
 :ctrl_block.donor_id := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If;
 :ctrl_block.donor_name := DON_STD.DONOR_NAME(:parameter.p_donor_id,szChapter);-- :global.chapter_id);
 :ctrl_block.donor_sex := DON_STD.DONOR_SEX (:parameter.p_donor_id,szChapter);-- :global.chapter_id);
 :ctrl_block.donor_dob := to_char(DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (:parameter.p_donor_id,szChapter),'MM-DD-YYYY') ;--:global.chapter_id), 'MM-DD-YYYY') ;
 :ctrl_block.donor_abo := DON_STD.DONOR_ABO (:parameter.p_donor_id,szChapter);-- :global.chapter_id);
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- IM 512
 
 go_block('valid_donproc_codes');
 execute_query;
 --pitss synchronize;
 check_perm_deferral;
END;
